index.title: Home
index.description: Supercharge Minecraft plugin development with modern, proven Java tools, developer-friendly APIs and structure that is actually readable.

docs-slug.title: Docs
docs-slug.description: The docs for Vital, the ultimate Minecraft plugin framework to supercharge Minecraft plugin development with modern, proven Java tools, developer-friendly APIs and structure that is actually readable.

all-features.title: All features
all-features.description: This page lists all features that the Vital framework currently has to offer.

code.title: Minimal Vital plugin (plugin.yml is automatically created)

features.title: Everything you need to create the best Minecraft plugins
features.description: Vital provides you with all of the features you need to start making that plugin you always wanted to. Build small to even massive plugins, the skies the limit.

autoconfigured.title: Autoconfigured
autoconfigured.description: Vital automatically manages your plugin configuration (plugin.yml) so you don't have to worry about forgetting to update it yourself.

powerful.title: Powerful
powerful.description: Vital was built with Spring Boot at its core. Create extensive plugins by utilizing proven Java tools from the Spring ecosystem. Don't worry, your plugins will stay as lightweight as they were before.

readable.title: Readable
readable.description: Finally create readable Minecraft plugins that you can work on by teams of developers. No more spaghetti code or stuff that barely works.

multiplatform-ready.title: Multiplatform ready
multiplatform-ready.description: Use Vital to create plugins for all of your favorite platforms, like: Spigot, Paper and BungeeCord. No extra configurations needed, everything from plugin configuration (plugin.yml) to command interaction is done by Vital.

modular.title: Modular
modular.description: Utilize Vital's module system to enhance your experience even more. Every module brings its own unique features like: advanced command system, minigame system, dynamic scoreboards, localization, inventory menus, interactable items, configs, etc.

lightweight.title: Lightweight
lightweight.description: Thanks to Vital's module system you can choose only the functionality you actually need for your project. No need to include the whole monolith if you only need the command system right? This keeps your project lightweight and easier to maintain.

cta.title: And even more...
cta.description: Vital is not just a small library, it is an entire ecosystem, specifically built to make Minecraft plugin development easier and more structured than ever before. It's the framework you never knew you needed but once you start using it, you never want to go back again!

documentation.title: Documentation
documentation.description: Check out the documentation to quickly get started with Vital or to get help with any component. Don't worry, the docs are NOT oversized and are easy to understand.

planned-features.title: Planned features
planned-features.description: These features are CURRENTLY NOT AVAILABLE but are planned for the future. If you have any ideas for other features please open up an issue on GitHub.

lite-mode.title: Lite Mode
lite-mode.description: You can also run Vital without Spring Boot while still benefiting from all of its features and functionality.

more-platforms.title: More Platforms
more-platforms.description: In addition to Spigot, Paper, and BungeeCord, Vital also supports other platforms such as Velocity and more.

web-initializer.title: Web Initializer
web-initializer.description: The initializer can also be used on the web to create your project, so it no longer needs to be run locally.

npcs.title: NPCs
npcs.description: With Vital, you can also create NPCs that perform their own actions, such as patrolling routes, reacting to player interactions, and more.

cta.title: All features
cta.description: This is a comprehensive list of all features the Vital framework currently has to offer. Note that these features are all separate modules that you need to add to your plugin in order to get the functionalities you need. The Vital module system makes your plugin smaller and so that it only contains the components your actually need for your plugin!

vital-commands.title: vital-commands
vital-commands.description: Create custom server commands using an annotation-driven design. Every command is a class, every subcommand '/mycommand arg' is a method that will automatically be called when your command is executed. The command system contains automatic tab-completions and a comprehensive and advanced system for handling exceptions. This system will change how you look at command creation!

vital-configs.title: vital-configs
vital-configs.description: Every config file will now be a class where every saved property is a class field with proper type-safety. Write to your class instead of juggling around with raw data. The config system also supports saving your own custom types.

vital-holograms.title: vital-holograms
vital-holograms.description: Easily create global holograms and even holograms that can only be seen by specific players. Display player statistics and more.

vital-inventories.title: vital-inventories
vital-inventories.description: Create inventory menus that your players can interact with and navigate between. Inventories are always dynamic and can also show translated titles and items via 'vital-localization'!

vital-items.title: vital-items
vital-items.description: Easily create items that your players can interact with. All items directly support cooldown and translations via 'vital-localization'.

vital-localization.title: vital-localization
vital-localization.description: Add a full localization (translations) solution to your plugin. Use resource bundles to show player-language specific texts. Combine it with modules like 'vital-items' and 'vital-inventories' for a more complete solution.

vital-minigames.title: vital-minigames
vital-minigames.description: The ultimate framework for making games using real game development patterns, like state machines, etc. Create games that either share their state with the entire server, or even host multiple games (instances) on the same server. Vital automatically routes events only to games and states that are currently active. This will bring your games to the next level!

vital-players.title: vital-players
vital-players.description: A custom player management solution so you can easily store data on your custom player objects.

vital-scoreboards.title: vital-scoreboards
vital-scoreboards.description: Easily create dynamic scoreboards that automatically update for all players when you change them, etc. Create global scoreboards to show the same data for all players, or create player scoreboards to show player specific data for all of your players.

vital-statistics.title: vital-statistics
vital-statistics.description: Integrated server TPS health checker to warn you when your server's TPS drops.

vital-tasks.title: vital-tasks
vital-tasks.description: Create server-scheduled tasks without having to worry about losing where you put it in your code base. Every task will be its own class that has strict lifecycles and structure so you always know what your task actually does.

vital-utils.title: vital-utils
vital-utils.description: Provides useful utilities, that can even be used when you are not using Vital. Broadcast actions, potion effects, teleport players with effects, censor words, converts raw text to adventure components, and more.
